about_the_game:
A Challenging Single-Player Strategy Game

This is a turn-based strategy simulation game with considerable difficulty, perfect for players seeking a real challenge!

The game features various map scenarios where players can select a faction and strive to unify the land by developing their nation and eliminating all rivals.

Map scenarios come in small, medium, and large sizes, allowing players to choose based on their preferences.

The game consists of two main sections:

  • Main Map: Semi-real-time combat mode

  • Internal Affairs: Activated after each in-game month ends

  • Game Features

    • Diverse Maps & Scenarios
      Currently designed maps include:

      • Three Kingdoms Period

      • Warring States Period (Sengoku Japan)

      • Fantasy Maps: Serene Moonlight / Wings in the Wind / Animal World / Ice & Fire Island

      • Historical Scenarios: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms / Tang & Song Dynasties / Battle of Gaixia

    • Four Difficulty Levels

      • Easy / Normal / Hard / Hell
        Each difficulty offers significantly different gameplay experiences to suit all types of players.

    • In-Depth Internal Affairs System
      Manage your nation through 8 key facilities:

      • Grand Hall (Administration) / Tech Research / Armory / Item Workshop

      • Shogunate (Personnel) / Prison / Minister of Agriculture / Training Ground
        ※ Additional functions like capital city customization are also available.

    • Tactical Combat System

      • General Skills: 18 carefully balanced abilities (overpowered skills removed to ensure strategic depth)

      • Diverse Unit Types:

        • Heavy Infantry / Swordsmen / Assassins (can blink to enemy backlines)

        • Bombers (AOE damage) / Magic Troops / Archers

      • Formation & Synergy: Unit composition, skill combinations, and formations are crucial to victory!
